args.text: Can you pull together every site on Marrow Agrisupply you can find across #central-team? List each with where it comes from. Need it before the customer call.

2. Pine Crossing. You, 9 Jun 2026, 10:48 AM. The morning receiver only sees the afternoon shift on the appointment screen. A driver who arrived at 7:10 got logged on a sticky note.
3. Wichita store (probably Marrow, but not confirmed). You, 2 Jul 2025, 9:21 AM. You mentioned an 8am check-in with "the Wichita store dispatcher" right after Tobias said your Zoom was hosting the Marrow Agrisupply office hours link. The message doesn't actually name Marrow, so check before you use it.

Not Marrow: the Tulsa hub (2 Jul 2025) is Tansley Parcel, and Door 6 / #88412 is Tansleigh Packaging.

The 9 Jun thread says three rows on Marrow's rollout tracker just read "waiting", but nobody named those stores in the channel. I couldn't find any other sites there.
